tools.name: get_design_data
tools.description: Use this tool to obtain the complete design data of a specific layer. The data will be provided in JSON format, describing the layer's style properties and nested structure. **Field Descriptions:** `$widthType` (and similarly `$heightType`) defines the sizing behavior for an element's width (or height) within an auto-layout: `0` Fixed, `1` Hug content, `2` Fill container (fills available space in the auto-layout). `direction` specifies the orientation of the auto-layout: `0` Horizontal, `1` Vertical. `counter` is analogous to the CSS `align-items` property: `0` Start, `1` Center, `2` End. `primary` is analogous to the CSS `justify-content` property: `0` Start, `1` Center, `2` End. `mode` determines whether the auto-layout element uses `justify-content: space-between`.
tools.title: 获取图层设计数据
